en.t: “The foxtrot is full of a foreign Western flavor.

units.source_text: 不过情况不同，也没什么，也可以踏着《木曾小调》的旋律来跳嘛。

en.t: But under different circumstances, there is nothing wrong with it; you can dance it to the tune of the Kiso Ballad too.

units.source_text: 木曾川，有撑撸的人，木曾川里湍流急水漫漫……”

en.t: On the Kiso River, there are people rowing with oars; in the Kiso River the swift current rushes on endlessly...”

units.source_text: 他唱着跳起木曾舞，舞场的人都笑了。

en.t: Singing, he began to dance the Kiso dance, and everyone in the dance hall laughed.
